title: Death of John Norseen

tellings.quote: Norine died while on business for Concurrent Technologies on September 27th, 2007.

plain: A man named John Norseen died on September 27, 2007, while travelling on business for a company called Concurrent Technologies, Michels says. He tells it himself, without naming a source, on an episode about American scientists who have died or gone missing. He brings it up as one case in what he sees as a possible pattern.
